title: Slope Emoji 2
desc: Slope Emoji 2 adds a colorful cast to the rolling-ball formula. Guide emoji faces down fast slopes, dodge obstacles and bombs, unlock more characters and push your name up the in-game leaderboard.
howto: Choose your emoji ball and start the slope.
Steer left and right through obstacles.
Avoid bombs and stay on the platform.
Collect likes to unlock more emoji characters.
Beat your best score on the leaderboard.
tips: Bombs end runs instantly; give them space.
Practice one emoji until your line control feels steady.
